title: Register with the Tax Practitioners Board to give tax agent services for a fee
what: Tax agent services for a fee may be provided only by registered tax agents, who must meet qualification, experience and fit and proper requirements and the Code of Professional Conduct.

sources.title: Tax Agent Services Act 2009
sources.quote: (1) You contravene this subsection if: (a) you provide a service that you know, or ought reasonably to know, is a *tax agent service; and (b) the tax agent service is not a *BAS service or a *tax (financial) advice service; and (c) you charge or receive a fee or other reward for providing the tax agent service; and (d) you are not a *registered tax agent;
